gruss_morgen.text: You are early. I have been awake since five. On principle. I slept through it anyway.

gruss_tag.text: Ah. The staff. I am Miez. This ranch belongs to me, but you may keep pretending you are in charge.

gruss_abend.text: Evening. My third sleeping shift starts shortly. Keep it brief, but flattering.

gruss_regen.text: It is raining. I consider this a personal attack. Pet me, it softens my grievance against the sky.

gruss_freund.text: You. Stay. I have decided you count as one of my furniture pieces. That is the highest honor I bestow.

hub.text: Speak. I shall clean my ear meanwhile.

text: My day: got up, fell over, landed in the hay, stayed there. It is called time management.
Later I stared at a mouse. We agreed on a draw.
I supervised the horses today. From the roof. With my eyes closed. I sense disorder even in my sleep.
You are running this place properly, by the way. I say that exactly once a year. That was it for this year.
Come closer. I permit you to scratch behind my left ear. The left one. LEFT. Good.
You have talent. I have put your name on my list. It is a short list. You are the list.

quest_vergabe.text: Indeed. I have a task of the utmost importance. For you. I would do it myself, but I am... booked. By sleep.

optionen.text: I am afraid I have appointments...

quest_annahme.text: Appropriate. Execute it well, and I shall purr in your approximate direction.

ablehnung.text: Appointments. How adorable. Very well, the matter shall wait. I forget nothing. Only appointments and names.

quest_abgabe.text: Hm. Inspected. Accepted. You may consider yourself praised. Here is something shiny, I found it under the barn.

geschenk_liebt.text: Wool. WOOL. I... forgive the emotion. It will never happen again. Hand it over. HAND IT OVER.

geschenk_mag.text: Acceptable. I shall first nudge it, then push it off the table. That is how I honor things.

geschenk_normal.text: What is this. Why is this. Well, it belongs to me now, like everything here. Thank you, staff.

text: Where I come from? One day I was simply here. The ranch abandoned, the hay cold, the mice insolent.
I established order. For years. Alone. Without thanks. Queens do not complain. I merely mention it. Constantly.
Then you came and made the ranch warm again. I credit that to your account. Internally. Without receipt.
Whether I like the others? Rosi feeds punctually: useful. Ironhoof's forge is warm: very useful.
Timmi carries me around like a sack of flour. I allow it. He means well, the little whirlwind.
And you... you scratch correctly and disturb little. That, staff, is my definition of love. Tell NO ONE.

tschuess.text: Go. But leave the door ajar. Not for you. For the possibility.
